mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_order_id) FROM t_payment_order p INNER JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id WHERE p.status = 'PREPAY_CREATED' AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.channel_transaction_no), '') IS NULL AND pr.expires_at < NOW() AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id ) ), 0) AS expiredPaymentCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_order WHERE status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' ), 0) AS pendingCallbackCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_event WHERE publish_status IN ('FAILED', 'DEAD_LETTER') ), 0) AS failedEventCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_refund_order WHERE status = 'FAIL' ), 0) AS failedRefundCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_day_end_batch WHERE batch_status = 'WARNING' ), 0) AS warningDayEndBatchCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_control_policy WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND COALESCE(self_check_status, 'WARN') <> 'PASS' ), 0) AS controlPolicyWarningCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT po.created_at, 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_order po WHERE po.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' UNION ALL SELECT pnl.created_at, 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_notify_log pnl WHERE pnl.notify_status = '待处理' UNION ALL SELECT pe.created_at, 'P2' AS severity FROM t_payment_event pe WHERE pe.publish_status IN ('FAILED', 'DEAD_LETTER') UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(pe.last_published_at, pe.created_at), 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_event pe WHERE pe.event_type = 'REFUND_SUBMIT' AND pe.publish_status = 'UNKNOWN' UNION ALL SELECT po.created_at, 'P2' AS severity FROM t_payment_order po INNER JOIN t_payment_channel_config pcc ON pcc.channel_code = po.channel_code WHERE pcc.status = 'DISABLED' ) issue_sla WHERE (issue_sla.severity = 'P1' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 30) OR (issue_sla.severity = 'P2' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 120) ), 0) AS overdueIssueCount

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_order_id) FROM t_payment_order p INNER JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id LEFT JOIN t_payment_expiry_close_retry retry ON retry.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id WHERE p.status = 'PREPAY_CREATED' AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.channel_transaction_no), '') IS NULL AND pr.expires_at < NOW() AND (retry.next_retry_at IS NULL OR retry.next_retry_at <= NOW()) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id )

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_order_id) FROM t_payment_order p INNER JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id INNER JOIN t_payment_expiry_close_retry retry ON retry.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id WHERE p.status = 'PREPAY_CREATED' AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.channel_transaction_no), '') IS NULL AND pr.expires_at < NOW() AND retry.next_retry_at > NOW() AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id )
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_event WHERE event_type = 'REFUND_SUBMIT' AND publish_status = 'UNKNOWN'

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT po.created_at, 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_order po WHERE po.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' UNION ALL SELECT pnl.created_at, 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_notify_log pnl WHERE pnl.notify_status = '待处理' UNION ALL SELECT pe.created_at, 'P2' AS severity FROM t_payment_event pe WHERE pe.publish_status IN ('FAILED', 'DEAD_LETTER') UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(pe.last_published_at, pe.created_at), 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_event pe WHERE pe.event_type = 'REFUND_SUBMIT' AND pe.publish_status = 'UNKNOWN' UNION ALL SELECT po.created_at, 'P2' AS severity FROM t_payment_order po INNER JOIN t_payment_channel_config pcc ON pcc.channel_code = po.channel_code WHERE pcc.status = 'DISABLED' ) issue_sla WHERE (issue_sla.severity = 'P1' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 30) OR (issue_sla.severity = 'P2' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 120)

SELECT issue_sla.issue_no AS issueNo, issue_sla.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, issue_sla.issue_type AS issueType, issue_sla.severity AS severity, COALESCE(roster.responsibility_group, CASE WHEN issue_sla.issue_type = '退款提交结果待核查' THEN '账务清结算联动组' ELSE '支付运营组' END) AS responsibilityGroup, COALESCE(roster.receiver, CASE WHEN issue_sla.issue_type = '退款提交结果待核查' THEN '账清结算联动值班' ELSE '支付运营' END) AS receiver, COALESCE(roster.escalation_receiver, CASE WHEN issue_sla.issue_type = '退款提交结果待核查' THEN '账清结算负责人' ELSE '支付值班负责人' END) AS escalationReceiver, COALESCE(roster.escalation_policy, CASE WHEN issue_sla.issue_type = '退款提交结果待核查' THEN '30分钟未核查升级账清结算负责人' ELSE '超时未确认升级值班负责人' END) AS escalationPolicy, COALESCE(roster.escalation_timeout_minutes, 30) AS escalationTimeoutMinutes, COALESCE(roster.schedule_tag, '默认班次') AS scheduleTag, CASE WHEN roster.effective_start_hour IS NULL OR roster.effective_end_hour IS NULL THEN '00:00-23:00' WHEN roster.effective_start_hour <= roster.effective_end_hour THEN CONCAT(LPAD(roster.effective_start_hour, 2, '0'), ':00-', LPAD(roster.effective_end_hour, 2, '0'), ':00') ELSE CONCAT(LPAD(roster.effective_start_hour, 2, '0'), ':00-次日', LPAD(roster.effective_end_hour, 2, '0'), ':00') END AS effectiveWindow, CONCAT('支付异常 ', issue_sla.issue_no, ' 已超过 ', issue_sla.severity, ' SLA，请进入异常中心处理。') AS alertContent FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('ISSUE-WAIT-', po.payment_order_id) AS issue_no, po.payment_order_id, '待回调未收口' AS issue_type, 'P1' AS severity, po.created_at FROM t_payment_order po WHERE po.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ISSUE-NOTIFY-', pnl.notify_no) AS issue_no, pnl.payment_order_id, '回调处理待跟进' AS issue_type, 'P1' AS severity, pnl.created_at FROM t_payment_notify_log pnl WHERE pnl.notify_status = '待处理' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ISSUE-EVENT-', pe.event_no) AS issue_no, pe.payment_order_id, '下游事件发布失败' AS issue_type, 'P2' AS severity, pe.created_at FROM t_payment_event pe WHERE pe.publish_status IN ('FAILED', 'DEAD_LETTER') UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ISSUE-REFUND-SUBMIT-UNKNOWN-', pe.event_no) AS issue_no, pe.payment_order_id, '退款提交结果待核查' AS issue_type, 'P1' AS severity, COALESCE(pe.last_published_at, pe.created_at) AS created_at FROM t_payment_event pe WHERE pe.event_type = 'REFUND_SUBMIT' AND pe.publish_status = 'UNKNOWN' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ISSUE-CHANNEL-', po.payment_order_id) AS issue_no, po.payment_order_id, '命中停用渠道' AS issue_type, 'P2' AS severity, po.created_at FROM t_payment_order po INNER JOIN t_payment_channel_config pcc ON pcc.channel_code = po.channel_code WHERE pcc.status = 'DISABLED' ) issue_sla LEFT JOIN t_payment_issue_duty_roster roster ON roster.issue_type = issue_sla.issue_type AND roster.severity = issue_sla.severity AND roster.status = 'ENABLED' AND FIND_IN_SET(WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 1, roster.weekday_scope) > 0 AND ( roster.holiday_strategy = 'ALL_DAYS' OR (roster.holiday_strategy = 'WORKDAY_ONLY' AND DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) BETWEEN 2 AND 6) OR (roster.holiday_strategy = 'NON_WORKDAY_ONLY' AND DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) IN (1, 7)) ) AND ( (roster.effective_start_hour <= roster.effective_end_hour AND HOUR(NOW()) BETWEEN roster.effective_start_hour AND roster.effective_end_hour) OR (roster.effective_start_hour > roster.effective_end_hour AND (HOUR(NOW()) >= roster.effective_start_hour OR HOUR(NOW()) <= roster.effective_end_hour)) ) WHERE ((issue_sla.severity = 'P1' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 30) OR (issue_sla.severity = 'P2' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 120)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_issue_alert_log alert_log WHERE alert_log.issue_no = issue_sla.issue_no AND alert_log.ack_status = '待确认' ) ORDER BY issue_sla.created_at ASC, issue_no ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT source_alert.issue_no AS issueNo, source_alert.alert_no AS sourceAlertNo, source_alert.payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, source_alert.issue_type AS issueType, source_alert.severity AS severity, source_alert.responsibility_group AS responsibilityGroup, COALESCE(roster.escalation_receiver, source_alert.receiver) AS receiver, COALESCE(roster.escalation_receiver, source_alert.receiver) AS escalationReceiver, COALESCE(roster.escalation_policy, '超时未确认升级值班负责人') AS escalationPolicy, COALESCE(roster.escalation_timeout_minutes, 30) AS escalationTimeoutMinutes, COALESCE(roster.schedule_tag, '默认班次') AS scheduleTag, CASE WHEN roster.effective_start_hour IS NULL OR roster.effective_end_hour IS NULL THEN '00:00-23:00' WHEN roster.effective_start_hour <= roster.effective_end_hour THEN CONCAT(LPAD(roster.effective_start_hour, 2, '0'), ':00-', LPAD(roster.effective_end_hour, 2, '0'), ':00') ELSE CONCAT(LPAD(roster.effective_start_hour, 2, '0'), ':00-次日', LPAD(roster.effective_end_hour, 2, '0'), ':00') END AS effectiveWindow, CONCAT('升级来源告警 ', source_alert.alert_no, ' 已超过 ', COALESCE(roster.escalation_timeout_minutes, 30), ' 分钟未确认，请升级跟进。原告警：', source_alert.alert_content) AS alertContent FROM t_payment_issue_alert_log source_alert LEFT JOIN t_payment_issue_duty_roster roster ON roster.issue_type = source_alert.issue_type AND roster.severity = source_alert.severity AND roster.status = 'ENABLED' AND FIND_IN_SET(WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 1, roster.weekday_scope) > 0 AND ( roster.holiday_strategy = 'ALL_DAYS' OR (roster.holiday_strategy = 'WORKDAY_ONLY' AND DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) BETWEEN 2 AND 6) OR (roster.holiday_strategy = 'NON_WORKDAY_ONLY' AND DAYOFWEEK(CURDATE()) IN (1, 7)) ) AND ( (roster.effective_start_hour <= roster.effective_end_hour AND HOUR(NOW()) BETWEEN roster.effective_start_hour AND roster.effective_end_hour) OR (roster.effective_start_hour > roster.effective_end_hour AND (HOUR(NOW()) >= roster.effective_start_hour OR HOUR(NOW()) <= roster.effective_end_hour)) ) WHERE source_alert.alert_channel = 'IN_APP_OUTBOX' AND source_alert.source_alert_no IS NULL AND source_alert.alert_content NOT LIKE '升级来源告警 %' AND source_alert.ack_status = '待确认' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, source_alert.created_at, NOW()) >= COALESCE(roster.escalation_timeout_minutes, 30) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_issue_alert_log escalated_alert WHERE escalated_alert.issue_no = source_alert.issue_no AND escalated_alert.alert_channel = 'IN_APP_OUTBOX' AND ( escalated_alert.source_alert_no = source_alert.alert_no OR escalated_alert.alert_content LIKE CONCAT('%升级来源告警 ', source_alert.alert_no, '%') ) ) ORDER BY source_alert.created_at ASC, source_alert.id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT task_log_no AS taskLogNo, task_code AS taskCode, task_name AS taskName, DATE_FORMAT(biz_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS bizDate, run_mode AS runMode, task_status AS taskStatus, task_status_type AS taskStatusType, processed_count AS processedCount, success_count AS successCount, warning_count AS warningCount, fail_count AS failCount, summary_comment AS summaryComment, triggered_by AS triggeredBy, DATE_FORMAT(started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS startedAt, DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS completedAt FROM t_payment_task_run_log ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_task_run_log WHERE task_code = 'PAYMENT_DAY_END' AND biz_date = #{bizDate} AND processed_count > 0 AND fail_count = 0

SELECT candidates.payment_order_id FROM ( SELECT p.payment_order_id, latest_attempt.created_at AS attempt_created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.channel_code ORDER BY latest_attempt.created_at, latest_attempt.id ) AS channel_rank FROM t_payment_order p INNER JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id INNER JOIN t_payment_attempt latest_attempt ON latest_attempt.id = ( SELECT pa.id FROM t_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id ORDER BY pa.created_at DESC, pa.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE p.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, latest_attempt.created_at, NOW()) >= #{minAgeSeconds} ) candidates WHERE candidates.channel_rank <= #{perChannelBatchSize} ORDER BY candidates.attempt_created_at, candidates.payment_order_id LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT candidates.payment_order_id FROM ( SELECT p.payment_order_id, latest_attempt.created_at AS attempt_created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.channel_code ORDER BY latest_attempt.created_at, latest_attempt.id ) AS channel_rank FROM t_payment_order p INNER JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id INNER JOIN t_payment_attempt latest_attempt ON latest_attempt.id = ( SELECT pa.id FROM t_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id ORDER BY pa.created_at DESC, pa.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT payment_order_id, COUNT(1) AS query_count, MAX(created_at) AS latest_query_at FROM t_payment_notify_log WHERE notify_status IN ('已查单', '查单失败') GROUP BY payment_order_id ) query_history ON query_history.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id WHERE p.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, latest_attempt.created_at, NOW()) >= #{minAgeSeconds} AND ( query_history.latest_query_at IS NULL OR TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, query_history.latest_query_at, NOW()) >= LEAST( #{maxRetryIntervalSeconds}, #{retryIntervalSeconds} * POWER( #{retryBackoffFactor}, LEAST(GREATEST(query_history.query_count - 1, 0), 20) ) ) ) ) candidates WHERE candidates.channel_rank <= #{perChannelBatchSize} ORDER BY candidates.attempt_created_at, candidates.payment_order_id LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT candidates.refund_order_id FROM ( SELECT refund.refund_order_id, CASE WHEN refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NOT NULL THEN refund_attempt.submitted_at ELSE COALESCE(refund_submit.last_published_at, refund_submit.created_at) END AS query_ready_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY refund_attempt.channel_code ORDER BY CASE WHEN refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NOT NULL THEN refund_attempt.submitted_at ELSE COALESCE(refund_submit.last_published_at, refund_submit.created_at) END, refund.id ) AS channel_rank FROM t_refund_order refund INNER JOIN t_refund_attempt refund_attempt ON refund_attempt.id = ( SELECT latest_attempt.id FROM t_refund_attempt latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.refund_order_id = refund.refund_order_id ORDER BY latest_attempt.created_at DESC, latest_attempt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN t_payment_event refund_submit ON refund_submit.id = ( SELECT event.id FROM t_payment_event event WHERE event.event_type = 'REFUND_SUBMIT' AND event.biz_no = refund_attempt.refund_attempt_no ORDER BY event.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE refund.status = 'PROCESSING' AND refund_attempt.channel_code IS NOT NULL AND ( (refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NOT NULL AND refund_attempt.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) OR (refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NULL AND refund_attempt.attempt_status = 'UNKNOWN' AND refund_submit.publish_status = 'UNKNOWN') ) AND TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, CASE WHEN refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NOT NULL THEN refund_attempt.submitted_at ELSE COALESCE(refund_submit.last_published_at, refund_submit.created_at) END, NOW() ) >= #{minAgeSeconds} ) candidates WHERE candidates.channel_rank <= #{perChannelBatchSize} ORDER BY candidates.query_ready_at, candidates.refund_order_id LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT candidates.refund_order_id FROM ( SELECT refund.refund_order_id, CASE WHEN refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NOT NULL THEN refund_attempt.submitted_at ELSE COALESCE(refund_submit.last_published_at, refund_submit.created_at) END AS query_ready_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY refund_attempt.channel_code ORDER BY CASE WHEN refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NOT NULL THEN refund_attempt.submitted_at ELSE COALESCE(refund_submit.last_published_at, refund_submit.created_at) END, refund.id ) AS channel_rank FROM t_refund_order refund INNER JOIN t_refund_attempt refund_attempt ON refund_attempt.id = ( SELECT latest_attempt.id FROM t_refund_attempt latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.refund_order_id = refund.refund_order_id ORDER BY latest_attempt.created_at DESC, latest_attempt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN t_payment_event refund_submit ON refund_submit.id = ( SELECT event.id FROM t_payment_event event WHERE event.event_type = 'REFUND_SUBMIT' AND event.biz_no = refund_attempt.refund_attempt_no ORDER BY event.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT attempt.refund_attempt_no, COUNT(log.id) AS query_count, MAX(log.created_at) AS latest_query_at FROM t_refund_attempt attempt LEFT JOIN t_refund_operation_log log ON log.refund_attempt_no = attempt.refund_attempt_no AND log.action_code IN ('CHANNEL_QUERY', 'CHANNEL_QUERY_FAILED') GROUP BY attempt.refund_attempt_no ) query_history ON query_history.refund_attempt_no = refund_attempt.refund_attempt_no WHERE refund.status = 'PROCESSING' AND refund_attempt.channel_code IS NOT NULL AND ( (refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NOT NULL AND refund_attempt.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) OR (refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NULL AND refund_attempt.attempt_status = 'UNKNOWN' AND refund_submit.publish_status = 'UNKNOWN') ) AND TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, CASE WHEN refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NOT NULL THEN refund_attempt.submitted_at ELSE COALESCE(refund_submit.last_published_at, refund_submit.created_at) END, NOW() ) >= #{minAgeSeconds} AND ( query_history.latest_query_at IS NULL OR TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, query_history.latest_query_at, NOW()) >= LEAST( #{maxRetryIntervalSeconds}, #{retryIntervalSeconds} * POWER( #{retryBackoffFactor}, LEAST(GREATEST(query_history.query_count - 1, 0), 20) ) ) ) ) candidates WHERE candidates.channel_rank <= #{perChannelBatchSize} ORDER BY candidates.query_ready_at, candidates.refund_order_id LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_order p INNER JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id INNER JOIN t_payment_attempt latest_attempt ON latest_attempt.id = ( SELECT pa.id FROM t_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id ORDER BY pa.created_at DESC, pa.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE p.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, latest_attempt.created_at, NOW()) >= #{minAgeSeconds}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_order p INNER JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id INNER JOIN t_payment_attempt latest_attempt ON latest_attempt.id = ( SELECT pa.id FROM t_payment_attempt pa WHERE pa.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id ORDER BY pa.created_at DESC, pa.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT payment_order_id, COUNT(1) AS query_count, MAX(created_at) AS latest_query_at FROM t_payment_notify_log WHERE notify_status IN ('已查单', '查单失败') GROUP BY payment_order_id ) query_history ON query_history.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id WHERE p.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, latest_attempt.created_at, NOW()) >= #{minAgeSeconds} AND ( query_history.latest_query_at IS NULL OR TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, query_history.latest_query_at, NOW()) >= LEAST( #{maxRetryIntervalSeconds}, #{retryIntervalSeconds} * POWER( #{retryBackoffFactor}, LEAST(GREATEST(query_history.query_count - 1, 0), 20) ) ) )

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_refund_order refund INNER JOIN t_refund_attempt refund_attempt ON refund_attempt.id = ( SELECT latest_attempt.id FROM t_refund_attempt latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.refund_order_id = refund.refund_order_id ORDER BY latest_attempt.created_at DESC, latest_attempt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN t_payment_event refund_submit ON refund_submit.id = ( SELECT event.id FROM t_payment_event event WHERE event.event_type = 'REFUND_SUBMIT' AND event.biz_no = refund_attempt.refund_attempt_no ORDER BY event.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE refund.status = 'PROCESSING' AND refund_attempt.channel_code IS NOT NULL AND ( (refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NOT NULL AND refund_attempt.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) OR (refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NULL AND refund_attempt.attempt_status = 'UNKNOWN' AND refund_submit.publish_status = 'UNKNOWN') ) AND TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, CASE WHEN refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NOT NULL THEN refund_attempt.submitted_at ELSE COALESCE(refund_submit.last_published_at, refund_submit.created_at) END, NOW() ) >= #{minAgeSeconds}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_refund_order refund INNER JOIN t_refund_attempt refund_attempt ON refund_attempt.id = ( SELECT latest_attempt.id FROM t_refund_attempt latest_attempt WHERE latest_attempt.refund_order_id = refund.refund_order_id ORDER BY latest_attempt.created_at DESC, latest_attempt.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN t_payment_event refund_submit ON refund_submit.id = ( SELECT event.id FROM t_payment_event event WHERE event.event_type = 'REFUND_SUBMIT' AND event.biz_no = refund_attempt.refund_attempt_no ORDER BY event.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT attempt.refund_attempt_no, COUNT(log.id) AS query_count, MAX(log.created_at) AS latest_query_at FROM t_refund_attempt attempt LEFT JOIN t_refund_operation_log log ON log.refund_attempt_no = attempt.refund_attempt_no AND log.action_code IN ('CHANNEL_QUERY', 'CHANNEL_QUERY_FAILED') GROUP BY attempt.refund_attempt_no ) query_history ON query_history.refund_attempt_no = refund_attempt.refund_attempt_no WHERE refund.status = 'PROCESSING' AND refund_attempt.channel_code IS NOT NULL AND ( (refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NOT NULL AND refund_attempt.submitted_at IS NOT NULL) OR (refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NULL AND refund_attempt.attempt_status = 'UNKNOWN' AND refund_submit.publish_status = 'UNKNOWN') ) AND TIMESTAMPDIFF( SECOND, CASE WHEN refund_attempt.channel_refund_no IS NOT NULL THEN refund_attempt.submitted_at ELSE COALESCE(refund_submit.last_published_at, refund_submit.created_at) END, NOW() ) >= #{minAgeSeconds} AND ( query_history.latest_query_at IS NULL OR TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, query_history.latest_query_at, NOW()) >= LEAST( #{maxRetryIntervalSeconds}, #{retryIntervalSeconds} * POWER( #{retryBackoffFactor}, LEAST(GREATEST(query_history.query_count - 1, 0), 20) ) ) )

SELECT SUM(query_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS query_count FROM t_payment_notify_log WHERE notify_status IN ('已查单', '查单失败') AND created_at >= TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, -#{lookbackHours}, NOW()) UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(1) AS query_count FROM t_refund_operation_log WHERE action_code IN ( 'CHANNEL_QUERY', 'CHANNEL_QUERY_SUCCESS', 'CHANNEL_QUERY_FAIL', 'CHANNEL_QUERY_FAILED' ) AND created_at >= TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, -#{lookbackHours}, NOW()) ) query_counts

SELECT SUM(failure_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS failure_count FROM t_payment_notify_log WHERE notify_status = '查单失败' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, -#{lookbackHours}, NOW()) UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(1) AS failure_count FROM t_refund_operation_log WHERE action_code = 'CHANNEL_QUERY_FAILED' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, -#{lookbackHours}, NOW()) ) failure_counts

SELECT SUM(rejection_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS rejection_count FROM t_payment_channel_query_rate_limit_log WHERE rejected_at >= TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, -#{lookbackHours}, NOW()) UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(1) AS rejection_count FROM t_refund_channel_query_rate_limit_log WHERE rejected_at >= TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, -#{lookbackHours}, NOW()) ) rejection_counts

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_issue_alert_log WHERE issue_type = #{issueType} AND alert_channel = 'IN_APP_OUTBOX' AND source_alert_no IS NULL AND ack_status = '待确认' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, -#{cooldownMinutes}, NOW())
